description: Problem 4 smoke tests: each Campus Customs MCP tool called by the vibe coder (Claude Code) through the project-level .mcp.json connection. Outputs are the exact JSON returned by the MCP server and were checked against data/campus_customs_new.db.

tests.prompt: Ticket 103: Yale AI Club wants 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M with a bulk discount. Use the campus-customs MCP server to check how many we have in size M, the shortfall, and the unit cost, list price, and margin.
tests.db_check: MATCH. inventory CC-HOOD-NAVY: S 4, M 8, L 14, XL 6 (all Aisle A); pricing: unit_cost 22.0, list_price 58.0. 58 - 22 = 36 margin; 20 - 8 = 12 shortfall.

tests.prompt: Ticket 101: Tauhid Zaman needs one CC-TEE-WHITE tee in size S. Use the campus-customs MCP server to check whether we can fill it from stock.
tests.db_check: MATCH. inventory CC-TEE-WHITE: S 0, M 5, L 3, XL 2 (all Aisle B); pricing: unit_cost 8.0, list_price 28.0.

tests.prompt: Ticket 101: the size S tee is out of stock. Use the campus-customs MCP server to list all open vendor invoices, and tell me whether any are overdue and whether the vendor is blocked from shipping.
tests.db_check: MATCH. desk.date_today 2026-08-31; invoices 501: vendor 1, 840.0, due 2026-08-28, open, 'Rush reprint CC-TEE-WHITE S'; vendors 1: Bulldog Print Co, apparel reprint, 5 lead days. 2026-08-31 minus 2026-08-28 = 3 days past due. Only one invoice exists, and it is open.

tests.prompt: Ticket 102: Elm City Properties emailed that shop rent is due in 2 days. Use the campus-customs MCP server to check lease 1 and confirm the rent amount, landlord, and when it is due.
tests.db_check: MATCH. leases 1: Chapel Street shop, Elm City Properties, 2400.0, next_due 2026-09-02, notes NULL; desk.date_today 2026-08-31, so the rent is due in 2 days and is not overdue.
